rationale.intuition: Wharton 是 Penn 内最难的项目: undergrad direct-admit 约 6% vs Penn overall ~5.4%; ED Wharton 估计 8-13% vs Penn ED overall ~14%. Wharton 是 hyper-selective sub-school, 强 unhooked profile (3.95/1560 + ICDC finalist + i-bank internship) ED 估计 10-25%. Engine 当前依赖 SchoolProgram lookup 给 majorMultiplier — 若 Penn 的 Finance/Business 项目未在 SchoolProgram 中按 verySelective band (70%) seed, 会落到 neutral 1.0 而忽略 Wharton 比 Penn overall 更难 — 这正是本 fixture 想暴露的 gap. Lower bound 0.08 允许 engine 即使 program data 缺失也能落在带内; upper bound 0.28 防止 ED boost over-inflation.

sources.name: Penn CDS 2024-25
sources.evidence: Penn overall admit rate 5.4%; ED rate ~14.3%. Wharton undergrad direct-admit historical rate ~6-7% per Compass Prep tracker (lower than Penn average due to direct-admit constraint).

sources.name: Compass Education Group - Wharton Admit Rate Tracker 2024
sources.evidence: Wharton direct-admit ED admit rate clusters 8-12% across 2022-2024 cycles; tougher than Penn College ED (~14-16%)

sources.name: Penn Admissions Office Class Profile 2028
sources.evidence: Wharton applicants self-report stronger quant credentials than Penn College pool; admit rate gap of 1-2pp ED-equivalent reported in Daily Pennsylvanian coverage
